description: This file defines Swagger API schemas for Recurring Deposit Accounts in the Fineract project, including data transfer objects (DTOs) for API responses, requests, and associated nested classes, but it does not contain executable logic or method implementations.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountsApiResourceSwagger.GetRecurringDepositAccountsTemplateResponse
classes.description: Response DTO for retrieving recurring deposit account templates, including client info and product options.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountsApiResourceSwagger.GetRecurringDepositAccountsResponse
classes.description: Main response DTO for retrieving detailed information about recurring deposit accounts, including status, timeline, currency, interest, deposit terms, and account chart.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountsApiResourceSwagger.PostRecurringDepositAccountsRequest
classes.description: Request DTO for creating a new recurring deposit account, including client ID, product ID, deposit details, and recurrence settings.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountsApiResourceSwagger.PostRecurringDepositAccountsResponse
classes.description: Response DTO after creating a new recurring deposit account, returning resource identifiers.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountsApiResourceSwagger.GetRecurringDepositAccountsAccountIdResponse
classes.description: Detailed account response with nested classes for account chart slabs and period types.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountsApiResourceSwagger.PutRecurringDepositAccountsAccountIdRequest
classes.description: Request DTO for updating account deposit amount and locale.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountsApiResourceSwagger.PutRecurringDepositAccountsAccountIdResponse
classes.description: Update response including the changes applied to the account.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountsApiResourceSwagger.PostRecurringDepositAccountsAccountIdRequest
classes.description: Empty request DTO for posting account ID specific actions.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountsApiResourceSwagger.PostRecurringDepositAccountsAccountIdResponse
classes.description: Response DTO with resource identifiers after posting account ID actions.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountsApiResourceSwagger.DeleteRecurringDepositAccountsResponse
classes.description: Response DTO for account deletion, including resource identifiers.
